correctness.rationale: The circular Fourier conditions are separated by ambient spherical-harmonic degree using the established nonvanishing and invariant-projector lemmas in arXiv:2609.27192v1, excluding even degrees >=2 by forbidden frequency 2 and odd degrees >=5 by forbidden frequency 5. The remaining support is R+a·u+Y_3. Exact planar fourth moments yield c(n)=Pi_n a-(1/4)grad_S Y_3(n). Averaging over S^2 and applying Delta_S Y_3=-12Y_3 give the inverse; orthogonality gives its norm identity. Positive definite spherical radius tensor for R sufficiently large realizes every claimed field and proves dimensionality. The bundled SymPy checker passed 15 cubic/plane and 5 divergence identities. These examples are not offered as an infinite proof.
